description: The Telkonet iBridge (models: IB8000, IB8001, IB8011, IB8200, IB8201, IB8211) and eXtender (models: X7000, X7001, X7011, X7200, X7201, X7211) use Telkonet's G3 AES v1.0 implemetation to provide cryptographic services in Telkonet's broadband internet solution which uses power line communications technology. Telkonet's G3 AES v1.0 is a firmware implementation of 256-bit AES which is used in Telkonet's Gateway models G3001 and G3201. The gateway is a component used to deliver broadband internet access using power line communications technology to connect to existing electrical wiring.
